title: observability: token-level cost + KV logging metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Summary: Add token-level cost and KV-cache logging metrics, extend Grafana dashboards, and tune noisy alerts. Motivation: token-level breakdowns help quantify per-customer unit economics and identify inefficient prompts; KV-cache visibility reduces decoder cost by surfacing cache hit/miss patterns and prefix eviction events. This PR includes Prometheus recording rules, improved structured logging for KV cache events, dashboard JSON updates, and alert threshold adjustments.
